what-to-wear.label: What should I wear?
answer: Come comfortable. Jeans, shorts, dresses, business casual — you'll see it all at Grace. There's no dress code.

parking.label: Where do I park?
answer: When you arrive, you'll find parking signs and a volunteer team to guide you. We recommend arriving 20 minutes early to make it easy.

kids.label: What's here for my kids?
answer: GraceKids is ready for birth through 4th grade with a secure check-in. Look for the GraceKids area when you arrive, or ask any team member.

nursing-room.label: Is there a space for nursing moms?
answer: Yes — we have a dedicated Mother & Baby Room where you can nurse or care for little ones while still watching the service in comfort.

quieter-space.label: Is there a quieter space?
answer: Yes. If loud sounds, bright lights, or crowds are difficult, our foyer overflow area is a quieter place to still fully engage with the message.

watch-online.label: Can I watch online instead?
answer: Absolutely. Join us live online Sundays at 9:20a — just park yourself on the sofa. Student videos and lessons are on Grace Online too.

pets-firearms.label: Can I bring my dog / carry a firearm?
answer: Only trained service animals are allowed (not emotional-support or therapy pets), out of care for allergies and fears. Open-carry firearms aren't permitted except for on-duty law enforcement.

how-to-give.label: How do I give to Grace Church?
answer: You can give online, by text, or in the Grace app. Note: 'Grace' can be confused with Grace Counseling — make sure you're giving to Grace Church at the link below.

recurring-gift.label: How do I set up a recurring gift?
answer: On our giving page, choose the repeating-gift option and set your amount and schedule. You can manage or change it anytime in the Grace app.

text-giving.label: How do I give by text?
answer: Text GIVE and your amount to 1 (844) 480-1053 and follow the one-time setup. After that, giving takes a few seconds.

giving-statement.label: How do I get a giving statement?
answer: Your giving history and year-end statements live in the Grace app under your giving profile — view or download them anytime.

non-cash-gift.label: Can I give stock, property, or a non-cash gift?
answer: Yes — Grace can receive non-cash gifts. Send us a message through the church office and our team will walk you through it.

where-gift-goes.label: Where does my gift go?
answer: Your generosity fuels the mission at Grace — ministry here in Orlando, care and counseling, and doing good in our community. Thank you.

talk-person.label: Talk to a person
answer: Happy to connect you with a real person. Call the church office at 407-418-1300, or send a message and the team will follow up. On weekends, Guest Services can walk you in.
